findings.finding: POST /users/:id/report and POST /messages/:id/report both correctly gate creation server-side: authenticate + writeRateLimiter + validateUuidParam, self-report blocked via req.user.id comparison (never trusted from body), and the mandatory prior-interaction check for user reports is a real DB query (shared Conversation OR target-owned Listing the reporter messaged about/saved) evaluated before any Report row is created, returning a clear 403 otherwise. Verified in rentals/backend/src/routes/users.ts and messages.ts.
Reason taxonomy is enforced server-side via z.enum per targetType (reportSchemas.ts), not just client-side in ReportModal, closing the gap the design-stage Trust & Safety review flagged.

Message snapshotting (body + senderId) happens atomically inside the same prisma.report.create call at report time, not a later live lookup — matches the design intent since messages are mutable with no audit trail.

Both new endpoints return only {success, message} (no report id, no target private fields), preventing enumeration of existing reports against a target, matching the existing listing-report response shape.

GET /admin/reports remains behind the router-level requireRole(ADMIN, MODERATOR) gate (no new privilege surface); the destructive ban action it triggers is still gated by the existing requireRole(ADMIN) on PATCH /admin/users/:id/ban, and the frontend now also hides the 'Restrict user' button from MODERATOR viewers for UX clarity (server-side gate was already correct).

Schema/migration change is additive and backward-compatible: targetType is nullable with a LISTING default (zero backfill needed), reportedUserId/messageId use onDelete: SetNull mirroring the existing listingId pattern, no existing column altered or made NOT NULL. Migration SQL was hand-authored (no live DB in this worktree) but matches the schema.prisma diff exactly and this is disclosed, not silently claimed as DB-verified.
findings.recommendedAction: Confirm with `prisma migrate diff` or a real `migrate dev` run against a live database before deploy, as the implementers already flagged.

findings.finding: Frontend renders reason/description/messageSnapshot/reporter and reportedUser fields as plain React text nodes (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML) in ReportModal.tsx and admin/page.tsx — no XSS vector introduced by the new user-controlled report content.

Report-message/report-user UI affordances are correctly restricted client-side (report button only on the other participant's messages/identity, never the viewer's own) and independently enforced server-side (self-report 400, participant-membership 403) — defense in depth, not reliant on the client.

notes: Independently reviewed the integrated worktree (not prior summaries): read the actual diffs for schema.prisma, the migration SQL, both new route handlers (users.ts, messages.ts), the admin.ts targetType branching, reportSchemas.ts, and the frontend ReportModal/Inbox/ListingDetail/admin page. Ran the real test suites myself: backend 211/211 passing, frontend 164/164 passing, both tsc builds clean. No authorization bypass, IDOR, data-exposure, XSS, or rate-limiting gaps found in the report-a-user/report-a-message surface. This is a security-only review; QA and Trust & Safety review of the implemented (not just designed) code are separate required gates per the founder's stated requirement and are not superseded by this approval.
